children: Laureate Education said a subsidiary in Peru acquired the capital stock of Universidad de Ciencias y Artes de América Latina, a Lima-based university, for around $35 million.
The subsidiary, Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas, will absorb UCAL following an integration process, Laureate Education said.

The deal includes around $25 million worth of real estate that will be used to expand UPC's footprint in Lima. The newly-added campus has capacity for roughly 5,000 students, currently has almost 2,500.

"This transaction furthers UPC's expansion in Metropolitan Lima, where it has strong demand but limited options to expand its existing campus, and advances UPC's vision of bringing quality education to more young people and supporting them at every stage of their educational journey," the company said.
